title: three builds

chapter.name: Bob
chapter.title: One question, asked three ways
chapter.stamp: Team Quest, then Six Flights, then Asterwind

lines: Six Flights wasn't our first choice.
Kate built Team Quest, which scored your rapport and energy.
It taught us that leading means spending trust,
but a score can't show you who's paying for your choices.
Then we pushed further with Asterwind, where you're in the room.
You make the call, then you have to say it to the person it costs,
in a sentence you build yourself.
It still costs her. But she knows she was part of the decision.
